claim: ADR 0193 item 3, amended by the founder's answer S202 (2026-10-12, F-618): making a menu current is itself a dated price change. MenusService.makeCurrent carries its lines with source 'menu_current' (a line added to the current menu stays 'import'), dated at made_current_at; migration 20270106000000 lets menu_price_versions.change_source and set_house_menu_price accept 'menu_current' (a stale one is still refused, a lock still holds) and has the S195 line-follows trigger skip it as it skips 'import'. Where a lock or a later person's price still differs from the live line, /menu (PricePick) and the wine's reading stand (PriceLockNote -> WineMenuPrices) say 'Locked at X -- the menu says Y' with a one-tap pick for an owner or a manager. Proven by supabase/tests/20270106000000_..._test.sql (PGlite, fails without the migration), menus.service.spec.ts, MenuNext.test.tsx, MenuPlan.test.tsx and PriceLockNote.test.tsx.
verify: grep -qF 'source: "menu_current",' apps/api-gateway/src/menus/menus.service.ts && grep -qF 'source: dating.source,' apps/api-gateway/src/menus/menus.service.ts && grep -qF "change_source IN ('manual', 'agent_accepted', 'import', 'backfill', 'menu_current')" supabase/migrations/20270106000000_making_a_menu_current_is_a_dated_price_change.sql && grep -qF "OR p_change_source NOT IN ('manual', 'agent_accepted', 'import', 'menu_current') THEN" supabase/migrations/20270106000000_making_a_menu_current_is_a_dated_price_change.sql && grep -qF "'') IN ('import', 'menu_current')" supabase/migrations/20270106000000_making_a_menu_current_is_a_dated_price_change.sql && grep -qF 'Locked at ' apps/web/src/pages/menu/next/PricePick.tsx && grep -qF 'the menu says ' apps/web/src/pages/menu/next/PricePick.tsx && grep -qF '<PricePick' apps/web/src/pages/menu/next/MenuNext.tsx && grep -qF '<WineMenuPrices' apps/web/src/pages/cellar/next/PriceLockNote.tsx
